objectives: 學習構機器人的基本幾何及運動學原理及在各領域的應用。學生在學期結束後應對機器人的結構, 設計及運動有充分的知識來評論市面上各類型機器人表現，也可建立自我設計機器人的基礎。
content:
Part A - Introduction to robotics
Chapter 0: Course introduction
Chapter 1: History
Chapter 2: Definition and terminology
Chapter 3: Classification
Part B - Kinematics of serial robots
Chapter 4: Definitions and geometrical tools
Chapter 5: Forward kinematics
Chapter 6: Denavit-Hartenberg parameters
Chapter 7: Inverse kinematics
Part C - Velocity model of robots
Chapter 8: Differential kinematics
Chapter 9: Jacobian direct formulation
Chapter 10: Singularity and manipulability
books:
教科書:
Introduction to Robotics: Mechanics and Control (Fourth Edition)，John J. Craig，Pearson，2004
Modern Robotics: Mechanics Planning, and Control，Kevin M. Lynch and Frank C. Park，Cambridge University Press，2017
機器人控制原理與實務，施慶隆、李文猶，2023.
